reviews.text:
I spoke with her on the phone a week ago and told her about my dog's situation. We had an appointment today at 10:30 am, and I had to text her to find out if she was coming. She said no because it was raining and that she'd come in a week. She didn't even bother to schedule an earlier appointment when I told her my dog's problem was getting worse. Then she said parking was a problem and she didn't want to come downtown.

1. You should give advance notice.
2. You can make arrangements or at least offer alternatives.
I didn't get to try the service; this was just my first impression.
